findings.title: Storm threatens lives of 1.76 million Palestinians sheltering in tents: Gaza media office
findings.affected_population_system: Displaced families sheltering in tents or structurally compromised buildings, especially children, elderly and sick people. Civil Defense spokesman Mahmoud Basal warned on Tuesday of anticipated heavy rain, strong winds and exposure risks amid inadequate heating. This is a prospective warning, not confirmed new flooding or casualties.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Gaza Civil Defense spokesman Mahmoud Basal warned that heavy rain could inundate the tents sheltering thousands of families
findings.source_type: Established news agency reporting named civil defense spokesperson
